name: zvideo_primary_surface_rect_scratch
description: zVideo::GetPrimarySurfaceRectScratch updates the scratch rectangle width and height from the primary surface state while preserving the origin.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4a7200 yet; current evidence is functional only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a7200 validates loading g_zVideo_PrimarySurfaceState.width and height, storing them to g_zVideo_PrimarySurfaceRectScratch.right and bottom, preserving left/top, and returning the scratch rectangle pointer.
The native zVideo smoke initializes the scratch rectangle origin and primary surface dimensions, then verifies the returned pointer and updated dimensions.
